IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark
brown hair wears a black strapless fitted top with a
crossed black strap around the neck. A black
leather mini skirt with rows of silver grommets and
buckle straps sits low at the hip, with long black
fingerless gloves on both arms. Tall black lace-up
platform boots with buckle straps complete the
look. Her expression is calm and direct. A soft
pastel gradient backdrop with even light. Palette of
black, silver, and pastel mint and butter yellow.
Bold and sleek, in the style of a Y2K fashion
catalog.
